caption: The drawing depicts a metal door handle and latch plate, rendered in grayscale pencil on a plain, off-white background. The handle is affixed to a vertically elongated, ornate backplate with decorative curved elements at the top and bottom. The backplate shows signs of texture and wear, with four visible mounting holes for attachment, two at the top and two at the bottom. Emerging from the right side of the backplate, closer to the top, is a spindle with a round, slightly bent lever handle. Below it, in the lower half of the backplate, is a larger, horizontally oriented pull handle with a rounded and fluted central section. Another metal piece, possibly the latch or bolt, protrudes horizontally from the left side of the backplate. The entire composition is centered on the page with ample blank space around the hardware.
title: Door Handle with Thumb Press
